attributes.text: Highlights and improvements in this release
attributes.originalText: Highlights and improvements in this release

attributes.text: Added Swap (Virtual RAM) overlay toggle under the RAM Overlays section with usage percentage and GB or MB unit formatting (#53).
attributes.originalText: Added Swap (Virtual RAM) overlay toggle under the RAM Overlays section with usage percentage and GB or MB unit formatting (#53).

attributes.text: Fixed root mode detection and switch lockout on KernelSU and APatch by inspecting mounts and requesting root execution directly.
attributes.originalText: Fixed root mode detection and switch lockout on KernelSU and APatch by inspecting mounts and requesting root execution directly.

attributes.text: Extended Device Diagnostics to show the active operating mode (Root vs Shizuku), detected root manager, su binary location, and version.
attributes.originalText: Extended Device Diagnostics to show the active operating mode (Root vs Shizuku), detected root manager, su binary location, and version.
